description: This file is a jQuery plugin implementing the FancyBox lightbox functionality, including methods for opening, closing, navigating, and configuring the lightbox, as well as internal private functions for handling content types, animations, and UI updates.

methods.name: fancybox
methods.description: Main jQuery plugin method to initialize or invoke the lightbox on selected elements.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Navigate to the next item in the current gallery.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Navigate to the previous item in the current gallery.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Navigate to a specific position in the gallery.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancel the current operation and close the lightbox.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resize the lightbox to fit the viewport.

methods.name: center
methods.description: Center the lightbox in the viewport.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialize the plugin, set up DOM elements and event handlers.
